title: Iterated triple-skip consumption bound
statement: Let $r$ be a partial reader on finite bit strings and let $b$ be a natural number. Suppose every successful read from $x$ to suffix $y$ satisfies $b+|y|\le |x|$. If the reader obtained by iterating the operation $f\mapsto (x\mapsto\text{apply }f\text{ three times})$ exactly $j$ times, starting from $r$, succeeds on $x$ with suffix $y$, then $b3^j+|y|\le |x|$.
hypotheses_covered: $r$ is a partial reader on finite bit strings
Each successful read consumes at least $b$ bits
The $j$-fold iteration of triple application to $r$ succeeds from $x$ with suffix $y$
